methodology: Preferred OpenReview forum candidates are used when explicitly marked; otherwise the public forum with the largest reviewer-note count is selected.
AA-SVD is intentionally tied to the rejected ICLR submission because the survey wants the rejection-cycle reviewer feedback.
Concern text is built from reviewer-authored weaknesses/questions fields for official reviews and the comment field for reviewer comments.
Categories are lexicon-based and overlapping: a single note can contribute to multiple concern categories.
Paper prevalence is computed over surveyed methods with public reviewer notes, not over methods with no accessible public review text.

figure_categories.label: Missing strong / pruning-matched baselines
figure_categories.description: Reviewer requests for stronger comparison baselines, especially pruning-aligned or otherwise omitted methods.

figure_categories.label: Inconsistent budget definitions
figure_categories.description: Reviewer concerns about fairness or semantics of compression ratios, rank budgets, or token/sample accounting.

figure_categories.label: Mixed-precision / remapping confounds
figure_categories.description: Reviewer concern that quantization, low-bit tricks, or remapping are mixed into what is nominally a pure low-rank comparison.

figure_categories.label: Narrow model / benchmark coverage
figure_categories.description: Reviewer requests for broader model families, larger scales, newer LLMs, or more representative benchmark coverage.

figure_categories.label: Non-end-to-end speed reporting
figure_categories.description: Reviewer concerns that throughput, latency, or speedup claims are not reported end-to-end or are compared under mismatched hardware/runtime settings.

figure_categories.label: High reproduction cost / missing artifacts
figure_categories.description: Reviewer signals that reproducing the method is hard because setup details, artifacts, or implementation specifics are missing.

supplemental_themes.label: Limited novelty / incremental delta
supplemental_themes.description: Reviewers questioning whether the claimed contribution is sufficiently novel.

supplemental_themes.label: Missing ablations / sensitivity analysis
supplemental_themes.description: Requests for ablations, sensitivity analysis, robustness checks, or stronger validation.

supplemental_themes.label: Clarity / theory explanation gaps
supplemental_themes.description: Requests for clearer derivations, theoretical explanation, or better presentation.
